name: NLVR2: Natural Language for Visual Reasoning with Paired Images
description: NLVR2 (Natural Language for Visual Reasoning 2) is a visual reasoning benchmark requiring models to determine whether a complex natural language sentence is true or false regarding a pair of real-world photographs. Comprising 107,292 linguistically diverse examples over 133,000 photos, it challenges models on semantic compositionality, spatial relations, numerical comparisons, and hard negation without linguistic shortcuts.
